input:
Earlier scenes:
古代的时候人觉得祭拜非常重要，孟子很小的时候，从早到晚一直祭拜，因为他妈妈告诉他祭拜很重要。虽然他没有朋友，因为每天只祭拜。他的同学们老是对他开玩笑了。孟子妈妈看了他的同学们对孟子不好的影响，所以孟子和孟子妈妈搬家了。孟子才十一岁，成为一个哲学家。孟子不是祭拜，而是看政治文章，难怪他成为了哲学家。不过，看过很多政治文章对他害得，他有很多问题。

This scene:
他一直问问题，但是不能解决那些问题。孟子长大，他开始能解决问题。他常常建议你不是学金融，而是学政治，因为如果你懂政治，你会成为高薪。后来孟子成为教授，他教学生很厉害。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 孟子长大，他开始能解决问题：长大以后，delete他，redundant
- 他常常建议你不是学金融，而是学政治：建议人们，不要学金融
- 因为如果你懂政治，你会成为高薪：delete the second你，redundant; 得到高薪，成为 + profession/celebrity

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 不是学金融，而是学政治：不要学金融，而要学政治，After 建议, use 不要……而要…… to state the action he advises against and the action he recommends; 不是……而是…… is for refuting or correcting a proposition. [teacher rule: bushi_ershi]
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 成为高薪：拿到高薪， 高薪 refers to high pay and cannot directly follow 成为; 拿到高薪 expresses earning a high salary. [rule: none]
3. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 孟子长大：他长大，孟子 was named in the immediately previous sentence and no other character competes as the referent, so a pronoun is more natural for close re-occurrence. [rule: character_introduction_first_mention]
4. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 孟子成为教授：他成为教授，The same character was just referred to as 他, so repeating the name is unnecessary in this close context. [rule: character_introduction_first_mention]
5. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 你：人们，The pronoun has no introduced referent in this narrative; use a full generic noun when referring to people in general. [rule: ambiguous_reference]
6. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 长大：长大了，Growing up is a completed change of state before he becomes able to solve problems, so it needs 了. [rule: aspect_le_completed]
7. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 成为教授：成为了教授，Becoming a professor is presented as a completed later event, so add 了 after the verb. [rule: aspect_le_completed]

items.reason: In this advice context, 不要……而要…… is the appropriate contrast, rather than 不是……而是…….
高薪 is pay, so it cannot be the complement of 成为; 拿到高薪 is correct.
孟子 is acceptable here, especially as the topic of the new growth stage, and the teacher did not replace it with 他.
孟子 is acceptable after the intervening advice material and is not an unnecessary reference error.
你 has no established addressee in this narration, while 人们 correctly gives the intended generic reference.
The growing-up change is completed before the next event, so 长大了 correctly marks that completion.
成为教授 is a completed later story event, so 成为了教授 correctly supplies perfective 了.
